Subject: BrightLane Order Form — initial redlines

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to move forward. Attached are our commercial redlines to the Order Form (see BrightLane_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf). Key items we highlighted:

- Minimum commitment cadence: we marked a preference for quarterly tranches rather than annual prepay.
- Net terms: procurement is requesting Net 60 for the first year (they note internal PO/payment cycles).
- VAT / tax handling: BrightLane is in the EU and will need the vendor to show VAT on invoices where applicable.
- Invoicing entity: please confirm which Redwood entity will issue invoices for US vs EU billing.

Can you confirm receipt and expected timeline for legal to review? Procurement would like a target of signing before 2027-11-15.

Regards,

Thanks Sean — quick commercial read and asks:

- Quarterly tranches: we can translate the annual $ commit to quarterly tranches (25% each) with standard volume discounts applied per quarter. I recommend a “staircase” approach for the first 2 quarters (Q1 75% of annual / Q2 100%) only if they need higher initial capacity — otherwise default to equal quarters.
- Pricing: confirm list rates + 10% introductory credit for first 90 days (to help trial) — ok to include as a one-line credit.
- Minimum commit: if they insist on quarterly, we need a floor of $50k/quarter to avoid small-ticket churn; willing to be flexible if finance signs off.

Attaching a simple workbook with proposed invoice timing scenarios: ACCT-clarity-invoice-schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB). Laura, can you confirm whether Net 60 vs Net 45 materially affects cashflow for this deal size? If we need Net 45, we should push for that.

Kimberly
Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: commercial redlines — legal suggestions

Sean / Kim — reviewed BrightLane redline PDF. High-level legal positions below (I’ll prepare a tracked-change file):

1) Invoice entity and tax: Redwood will invoice from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) for services rendered to US customers. For EU billing, we can provide EU-local invoicing through Redwood Inference EU Ltd (subject to contractual annex). Customer pays any applicable VAT/indirect taxes unless Redwood is required by local law to collect; in that case we will add VAT to our invoices and pass it through.

2) Net terms: propose counter to Net 45 across the board. If customer insists on Net 60, we can accept Net 60 for Year 1 only in exchange for either (a) a modest delay in crediting intro credit, or (b) a 10% prepayment on first invoice (deposit) to mitigate risk.

3) Minimum commit / staged tranches: accept quarterly tranches but include explicit minimum per quarter and a clause that unconsumed credits do not roll beyond 12 months. Also propose language for early termination clawback of promotional credits.

4) Attachments: I’ll upload a consolidated redline: BrightLane_OrderForm_v2_consolidated_redline.pdf and suggest we run a short legal call if BrightLane wants to negotiate further.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: finance check — net terms & deposit

Team — finance view:

- Net 60 is acceptable for this customer only if we take a 10% deposit on the initial invoice (applied to the first quarter). That reduces DSOs for the ramp month and protects us against PO delays.
- If we accept Net 60 without deposit, we need a credit hold clause and AR contact in procurement (we should get a primary / backup contact).
- VAT: we will accept that BrightLane pays VAT. Redwood will show VAT separately on invoices where applicable. Finance needs the final billing entity to set tax rules in the invoicing system.

Action: Ben / Sean, please confirm preferred billing entity string (I.E. Redwood Inference, Inc. or Redwood Inference EU Ltd) and I’ll provision the invoice flow.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Howard <alice.howard@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated Redwood positions on Order Form redlines

Alice — thanks for the redlines and patience while we reviewed internally. Summary of our consolidated positions (attached consolidated redline PDF):

- Tranches / minimums: We can move to quarterly tranches. Standard approach: equal 25% tranches with a minimum of $50k/quarter. If BrightLane prefers a ramp, we can accommodate a 75%/100% staircase for Q1/Q2 with a note in the pricing schedule.
- Pricing credit: a one-time 10% introductory credit applicable to the first 90 days — reflected as a line item credit on the first invoice.
- Net terms & deposit: Redwood requests Net 45 standard. However, we will accept Net 60 for Year 1 only if BrightLane agrees to a 10% deposit applied to the first invoice. If BrightLane still prefers Net 60 without deposit, please provide accounts-payable primary contact and expected PO timeline so we can enable credit hold controls.
- VAT & invoicing entity: Redwood will show VAT on invoices where applicable and pass VAT to BrightLane. For this deal Redwood will invoice from Redwood Inference EU Ltd for EU billing and Redwood Inference, Inc. for US billing. Laura will provision invoices once we receive final billing entity confirmation.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you can accept the 10% deposit + Net 60 option, or whether you prefer Net 45.
2) If you accept Net 60 + deposit, I’ll send a DocuSign envelope for the consolidated redline (link below).

DocuSign (proposal): https://docusign.com/redirect/ABC123-brightlane
Attachment: BrightLane_OrderForm_v2_consolidated_redline.pdf (PDF, 148KB)

Appreciate a reply by 2027-11-10 to keep to your internal timelines.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
